name: 썸네일 일관성 분석
description: 비교합니다 embedded EXIF thumbnail with the main image 감지하기 위해 post-capture modifications.
algorithm: Embedded Thumbnail vs Main Image Structural Comparison
mechanism: JPEG files often contain embedded thumbnails generated at capture time. When the main image is later edited, the thumbnail may remain unchanged, creating detectable 불일치.
parameters: Comparison: SSIM, Histogram 상관관계, Pixel hash, Thumbnail source: EXIF APP1, 해상도: 160×120
source: Kee, E. & Farid, H. (2011) — Digital Image Authentication from Thumbnails, SPIE Electronic Imaging
useCase: Detecting image editing 비교하여 original thumbnail with potentially modified main image

references.title: Kee, E. & Farid, H. (2011) — Digital Image Authentication from Thumbnails, SPIE Electronic Imaging

strengths:
• Simple and fast 분석
• High confidence when thumbnail differs
• Non-invasive 메타데이터 check
• Works on any JPEG with embedded thumbnail
limitations:
• Many images lack embedded thumbnails
• Some editors update thumbnails too
• AI 생성 images may not have thumbnails
• Limited to JPEG format
